name: Volumetric Ray Tracing with Global Illumination
definition: A rendering method for scenes containing both volumetric and geometric data that extends the standard ray tracing illumination equation to capture global illumination effects (shadows, reflections) and volume rendering effects (compositing, maximum-value projections) in a single image.
summary: Volumetric Ray Tracing with Global Illumination renders scenes with both geometric and volumetric data by capturing global illumination and volume effects in a single image, differing from pure methods by explicitly handling geometric intersections and recursive ray paths.
